snippet.title: Dark Cards of Candlewood - Official Announcement Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Dark Cards of Candlewood is a solo collectible card game with the soul of a classic JRPG. Embark on replayable dungeon runs with deceptively deep, two-choice card combat. Draft items for your backpack, master chain attacks, and even crack a few card packs...then save the world from eternal darkness! Check out the Dark Cards of Candlewood trailer for this deckbuilder game to see what you can expect. Dark Cards of Candlewood will be available on PC. A demo is available now.
